name: Ding Dong
summary: A doorbell button that rings a two-tone chime, lights the hall and swings the front door open
about: A glowing doorbell on a house front at dusk. Pressing it sinks the button and rings a ding and a lower dong with rings, notes and words, then the hall light comes on behind the little window, a shadow walks past and the knob turns. The door swings open on a spring, warm light spills over the mat and the host waves you in before the door bumps shut and the porch lamp fades.
how: Press the bell (or Tab to it and press Enter or Space) to ring.
Watch the hall light, the shadow and the knob, then the door opens and the host greets you.
Ring again while they are on the way to hurry them up.
Use the Chime button to turn the real two-tone sound on or off.
